say.speaker: partner
say.text: Look at them run! Maybe Dad knew what he was talking about with all those evening drills after all!

say.speaker: healer
say.text: Still, why were rough thugs lurking so close to our village? Let's haul the water home and tell Quaquaval and Mom right away.

say.speaker: combee
say.text: Wait up, we are coming to warn Quaquaval too! Our hive courier buzzed by and said they can spare us for a day, and someone ought to keep watch while thugs are prowling the trail!
